caption: May 20, 2025. The former Chief Analyst for Military Records of the Assassination Records Review Board — the federal board that reviewed the JFK files — testified to a House Oversight task force, under oath. His testimony: the surviving JFK skull X-rays in the National Archives are not originals but altered copy films, and two physicians granted archive access conclude they show a total of three head shots — one from behind, two from the front. That contradicts the Warren Commission and the House Select Committee on Assassinations. He also testified that the original X-rays, eight sets of autopsy photographs, and President Kennedy's brain are missing from the official collection. One cable network covered the hearing. The New York Times, the Washington Post, CNN, NBC, CBS, and ABC did not. The lone mainstream column that engaged the task force called it "a bleak farce." See the receipts.

Presented as testimony, not asserted as settled fact.
